description: This file defines the class `GenericHelperDAO`, which implements data access operations for entity objects within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting entities (GenericValue objects), as well as facilities for querying with conditions and managing database interactions.

classes.name: GenericHelperDAO
classes.description: A data access object class that provides CRUD operations and query support for entity objects in the OFBiz framework, utilizing an underlying GenericDAO.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper as specified in helperInfo.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the database from a GenericValue object.

methods.name: createAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of GenericValue entities into the database.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue by its primary key, only fetching specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entities by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Deletes an entity identified by its primary key.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Performs a conditional query, returning an iterator over matching entities.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Retrieves entities related through multiple relation models.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Updates an entity in the database.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Updates multiple entities matching a condition with specified fields.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Checks database consistency with the entity model, optionally adding missing entities or fields.
